en.title: A Mammal That Lays Eggs! Can You Name This Animal?
en.description: The long-beaked echidna is a mammal that lays eggs. At up to 16.5 kg it is the largest living monotreme, and it lives in the mountain forests of western New Guinea, where it is critically endangered.
